text.en:
The Act entitled "An Act providing for the organization of three companies of police for the city
of Manila and neighboring towns," is hereby amended by striking out the words "American volunteer
soldiery now serving" in section one thereof, and inserting in lieu the words "honorably discharged soldiers
and sailors of the United States who are now serving or have served."

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, January 26, 1901.
